description: holon-coherence ships a versioned .githooks/commit-msg hook for commit-trailer enforcement, but Makefile has no install-hooks target to configure core.hooksPath .githooks automatically in target checkouts.
goal: Add an idempotent install-hooks target to Makefile (listed in .PHONY and help, respecting DRY_RUN=1 consistently with existing Makefile targets) that verifies .githooks/commit-msg exists and is executable and sets git config core.hooksPath .githooks for the repository/worktree. Add automated tests in tests/test_makefile.py (covering install-hooks DRY_RUN, help listing, and real git core.hooksPath activation in a temporary git repository) and verify commit-msg hook enforcement with scripts/check_commit_trailers.py in tests/test_check_commit_trailers.py. Do NOT create new Python files, do NOT modify .github/workflows/test-commit-trailers.yml, and do NOT modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Providing a tested, idempotent make install-hooks target activates local commit-msg trailer enforcement automatically in target worktrees.
acceptance_criteria: Makefile provides an idempotent install-hooks target (in .PHONY and help, supporting DRY_RUN) that activates versioned .githooks/commit-msg via git config core.hooksPath .githooks in target worktrees.
Automated tests verify hook installation and commit-trailer enforcement under `uv run pytest`.

All changes remain within Makefile, tests/test_makefile.py, and tests/test_check_commit_trailers.py (zero new Python files; holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched), uv run task lint passes, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
